server.name: io.github.mrorigo/bash-command-mcp
server.description: Sophisticated bash command MCP server that runs and manages shell execution.

environmentVariables.description: Enable or disable OpenTelemetry instrumentation (`true` or `false`).
environmentVariables.name: OTEL_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: OpenTelemetry service name override.
environmentVariables.name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME

environmentVariables.description: OpenTelemetry service version override.
environmentVariables.name: OTEL_SERVICE_VERSION

environmentVariables.description: OTLP HTTP endpoint for exporting OpenTelemetry traces and metrics (for example `http://localhost:4318`).
environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT

environmentVariables.description: OpenTelemetry metrics export interval in milliseconds.
environmentVariables.name: OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL_MS

environmentVariables.description: Directory used to store background process stdout/stderr log files.
environmentVariables.name: BASH_COMMAND_MCP_LOG_DIR
